name: DPC stake changes duplicate accrued reward quota
summary: DPC's stakeLp and claimStakeLp add getClaimQuota(account) to oldClaimQuota, but getClaimQuota already returns time-accrued quota plus oldClaimQuota. Each stake change therefore duplicates the existing accrued credit, and credit doubles with every call. claimDpcAirdrop pays that credit in DPC from the contract's reserve, bounded only by the purchased dpcAirdrop allotment and bypassing the LP-stake-by-time vesting. The first duplication is an ordinary stakeLp at block 21178424. The exploiter bought 45 allotments through helper 0x2109bbec, staked dust LP, and repeated claimStakeLp(1 wei). It claimed 22,390 DPC and sold it into the DPC/USDT pair. The seed description incorrectly claimed that elapsed-time accrual was absent.
notes: The operator's changeIsClaim(true) opens claimDpcAirdrop, the only path that pays duplicated quota out of the contract reserve (require(isClaim)). Before it, duplicated credit could accrue but never be redeemed. It is the sole isClaim write between deployment and the anchor, and no later configuration touches the quota logic.

The exploiter's realised net USDT: the DPC/USDT pair paid 0xf211fa86 78,213.799601795586855413 USDT in three sales of claimed DPC, less the 4,598 USDT that 0xf211fa86 sent to its helper to buy 45 allotments (4,500 USDT) and seed LP. The DPC came from the contract's own reserve through claimDpcAirdrop, so the USDT drained from pair LPs is at least this amount. The helper's residual (about 0.60 USDT and 12.298905560438538 staked LP) is not added. The 70% (ucur1) and 15% (referral) splits of the allotment purchases are not netted back. The seed/Beosin $103,755 is not reproduced and is not used.
